title: Verify dynamic HDR encode output before publish
summary: Add a fail-closed Dynamic HDR output verification gate for preservation-ready CPU/libx265 encodes before publish.
reason: Dynamic HDR extraction and x265 parameter wiring were present, but the pipeline still needed to prove that the produced encode exposed the expected Dolby Vision or HDR10+ metadata before allowing publish.
behavior_before: Preservation-ready Dynamic HDR encodes could proceed from successful FFmpeg execution into quality, size, and publish checks without a dedicated output-metadata verification step.
behavior_after: Preservation-ready Dynamic HDR encodes probe the encoded temp output before quality, size, and publish checks; missing or inconclusive Dolby Vision/HDR10+ metadata records operator-required failure evidence and blocks publish.
manual_validation: PowerShell parser check for modified scripts - passed
rollback_plan: Revert the Dynamic HDR output verification helper, encode-stage verification gate, new failure codes, targeted test assertions, generated summaries, and status-doc updates in this packet.
